title: 初めての電報機械「ブレゲー指字電信機」の仕組みと動作
lineage: Technical institutional retrospective based on a replica and fragmentary information; the authors say their model may not fully reproduce the historical machine.

passages.note: NTT describes blank dial rows used for national languages, with iroha entered in Japan, and synchronized pointer operation. It says the original device has 26 positions while its modern working model has 24.
